response.sql:
WITH sex_counts AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_missing,
        CASE
            WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN ''
            ELSE p.SEX
        END AS sex_group,
        COUNT(*) AS examination_count
    FROM Examination AS e
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY
        CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        examination_count,
        1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share,
        AVG(examination_count) OVER () AS average_count
    FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT
    SUM(examination_count) AS total_examination_count,
    AVG(share) AS average_share,
    AVG(examination_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM scored
WHERE examination_count > average_count;

assumptions.assumption: Whitespace-only SEX values are grouped with blank SEX; missing SEX is a separate group. The average count is across all resulting sex groups, and shares use the combined count of examinations matched to patients.

alternatives.interpretation: If only the exact empty string is blank and whitespace-only values should remain separate groups, replace each `TRIM(p.SEX) = ''` condition with `p.SEX = ''`.
